title: Rocket Pharmaceuticals Shares Rise 8% After FDA Alignment on Danon Disease Trial
summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:RCKT) shares rose 8% on Tuesday after the company said it reached alignment with the US Food and Drug Administration on the pivotal Phase 2 trial of RP-A501 for Danon disease. The FDA confirmed a pivotal efficacy population of 12 patients, including the first three patients treated under the study’s modified protocol, according to Rocket.
